subject.title: fix(matrix): tolerate SAS accept events missing method

question: Should OpenClaw carry a plugin-local wrapper around matrix-js-sdk’s internal Rust-crypto backend for this malformed Element SAS accept event, or require an upstream/public SDK solution first?
rationale: The proposed behavior changes the data reaching the crypto preprocessor through an undocumented MatrixClient implementation detail; selecting the long-term compatibility boundary requires owner intent rather than an automated repair.

options.title: Approve the narrow compatibility wrapper
options.body: Accept the plugin-local workaround after current-head live SAS proof confirms it restores verification and does not alter valid events.

options.title: Pursue an upstream SDK contract
options.body: Pause this PR until matrix-js-sdk exposes or adopts a supported compatibility hook for malformed to-device verification events.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow compatibility wrapper
recommendation.body: Accept the plugin-local workaround after current-head live SAS proof confirms it restores verification and does not alter valid events.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent commits show direct ownership of the Matrix E2EE startup, verification, and crypto-bootstrap path affected by this decision.
